newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day Treasury bills yield 6.266 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day Treasury bills yield 6.266 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said on Thursday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.266 percent at its auction of 91-day Treasury bills for 80 million ringgit.
At its previous auction for 91-day bills on February 13 for 80 million ringgit, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.269 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.280/230.
At its auction of 364-day bills, the bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.165 percent.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.180/137.
